prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The movie was so _____ that I fell asleep.
options: boring
bored
bore

wrong.bored: bored 形容人的感受（覺得無聊），但這裡形容的是電影本身。
wrong.bore: bore 是動詞原形，不能放在 so 後面當形容詞。

why: 形容事物令人感到無聊，用現在分詞形容詞 boring。
say: The movie was so boring that I fell asleep.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: I was _____ by the test result.
options: shocked
shocking
shock

wrong.shocking: shocking 是「令人震驚的」，形容事物；我是感到震驚的人，要用 shocked。
wrong.shock: shock 是動詞或名詞原形，was 後面不能直接接原形。

why: 主詞 I 是感受到震驚的人，用過去分詞 shocked。
say: I was shocked by the test result.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Walking along the river, I saw a rabbit.
Walking along the river, a rabbit appeared.
Walked along the river, I saw a rabbit.
answer: Walking along the river, I saw a rabbit.

wrong.Walking along the river, a rabbit appear: 分詞構句的主詞要和主句主詞一致，走在河邊的是人，不是兔子，這是懸垂分詞的錯誤。
我是主動走路，要用現在分詞 walking，不能用被動意味的 walked。

why: walking 的動作者是 I，與主句主詞相同，才是正確的分詞構句。
tip: 分詞構句的主詞要和主句主詞相同。
say: Walking along the river, I saw a rabbit.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: Left alone, the baby began to cry.
options: 被獨自留下時，寶寶開始哭
寶寶獨自離開之後哭了
寶寶留下大人自己哭了
answer: 被獨自留下時，寶寶開始哭

wrong.寶寶獨自離開之後哭了: left 在這裡是被動「被留下」，不是主動「離開」。
wrong.寶寶留下大人自己哭了: alone 說的是寶寶獨自一人，不是大人被留下。

why: Left alone 是過去分詞構句，意思是「被留下一個人」。
tip: 過去分詞開頭，通常是被動意思。
say: Left alone, the baby began to cry.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: _____ in 1990, the bridge is still strong.
options: Built
Building
Having build

wrong.Building: 橋是「被建造」，要用被動的過去分詞，building 是主動意思。
wrong.Having build: having 後面要接過去分詞 built，build 是原形，用法錯誤。

why: 橋被建造，所以用過去分詞 Built 開頭。
tip: 被動的分詞構句用過去分詞。
say: Built in 1990, the bridge is still strong.

prompt: 你聽到一個消息，覺得很驚訝。哪一句最自然？
options: I was surprised at the news.
I was surprising at the news.
I surprised at the news.
answer: I was surprised at the news.

surprising 是「令人驚訝的」，描述事物；你是感到驚訝的人，要用 surprised。
缺少 be 動詞，surprised 在這裡是形容詞，要寫 I was surprised。

why: 人感到驚訝，用 be surprised at。
tip: be surprised at 是對…感到驚訝。
say: I was surprised at the news.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The girl sitting by the window is my cousin.
The girl sat by the window is my cousin.
The girl is sitting by the window is my cousin.
answer: The girl sitting by the window is my cousin.

sat 是過去式動詞，不能直接放在名詞後面修飾；要用分詞 sitting。
wrong.The girl is sitting by the window is my: 一個句子出現兩個動詞 is，要把前一個改成分詞 sitting 當修飾語。

why: sitting by the window 是現在分詞片語，修飾 the girl。
tip: 分詞片語可直接放在名詞後修飾。
say: The girl sitting by the window is my cousin.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: There was a _____ glass on the floor.
options: broken
breaking
break

wrong.breaking: breaking 是正在破裂的意思，掉在地上的杯子是「已經破的」。
wrong.break: break 是動詞原形，放在名詞前面不能當形容詞。

why: 杯子是被打破的，狀態已完成，用過去分詞 broken。
tip: 已完成的被動狀態，用過去分詞。
say: There was a broken glass on the floor.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: Not knowing the answer, Ken stayed silent.
options: 因為不知道答案，Ken 保持沉默
Ken 知道答案，但保持沉默
Ken 不想知道答案，所以沉默
answer: 因為不知道答案，Ken 保持沉默

wrong.Ken 知道答案，但保持沉默: Not knowing 是「不知道」，與選項的「知道」相反。
wrong.Ken 不想知道答案，所以沉默: 句中沒有說他「不想」知道，只說他不知道。

why: Not knowing 表示原因，因為不知道答案所以沉默。
tip: 否定分詞構句，not 放在分詞前面。
say: Not knowing the answer, Ken stayed silent.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Having eaten dinner, we went for a walk.
Having ate dinner, we went for a walk.
Have eaten dinner, we went for a walk.
answer: Having eaten dinner, we went for a walk.

having 後面要接過去分詞 eaten，不能用過去式 ate。
分詞構句要用 having，不能用 have 當開頭。

why: 先吃飯、後散步，用 Having eaten 表示先完成。
tip: 先完成的動作，用 having + p.p.。
say: Having eaten dinner, we went for a walk.

prompt: 你覺得這本書很有趣，你也對它很感興趣。哪一句完全正確？
options: I find this book interesting, so I am interested in it.
I find this book interested, so I am interesting in it.
I find this book interesting, so I am interesting in it.
answer: I find this book interesting, so I am interested in it.

wrong.I find this book interested, so I am int: 兩個形容詞都用反了，書是 interesting，人是 interested。
wrong.I find this book interesting, so I am in: 前半句正確，但 I am interesting 是「我很有趣」，要改成 interested。

why: 書「令人感興趣」用 interesting，人「感到興趣」用 interested。
say: I find this book interesting, so I am interested in it.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: When _____ the meeting, please turn off your phone.
options: attending
attended
attend

wrong.attended: 過去分詞表示被動，但參加會議是主動的動作。
wrong.attend: when 後面省略主詞時要接分詞，不能直接接動詞原形。

why: 省略主詞的 when 子句，主動意思用現在分詞 attending。
tip: when 加 V-ing，表示做…的時候。
say: When attending the meeting, please turn off your phone.
